visual.title: Depth-first follows one branch
visual.caption: Depth-first search follows one neighbour as far as it can before backtracking. The visit order is the discovery order, and the highlighted edges form the depth-first tree.

predict.question: After A → B → C, which node does depth-first discover next?
predict.explain: From C the unvisited neighbour is F, so depth-first goes to F before returning to C. D and E are reached only after that branch is exhausted.
